components.css: .ds-row{font-family:'Instrument Sans Variable','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;display:grid;grid-template-columns:22px 42px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:8px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--toner-3,#2d2d2b);color:var(--ink,#f0f0ec);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;} .ds-row .ds-check{display:inline-block;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--acid,#c4f236);margin-top:2px;} .ds-time{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--toner-2,#898985);padding-top:2px;} .ds-artist{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--toner-1,#a7a7a1);} .ds-status{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink,#f0f0ec);} .ds-track{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.02em;line-height:1.08;} .ds-mark{background-image:linear-gradient(transparent 12%,var(--acid,#c4f236) 12%,var(--acid,#c4f236) 92%,transparent 92%);background-repeat:no-repeat;color:var(--on-acid,#0d0d0d);padding:0 3px;margin:0 -3px;border-radius:3px;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone;animation:ds-swipe 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);} @keyframes ds-swipe{from{background-size:0% 100%;}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-mark{animation:none;}} .ds-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;column-gap:12px;margin:4px 0 0;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;} .ds-links a{color:var(--ink,#f0f0ec);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--toner-3,#2d2d2b);text-underline-offset:2px;} .ds-links a:hover{text-decoration-color:var(--ink,#f0f0ec);} .ds-links a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#c4f236);outline-offset:2px;}

narrative.overview:
The side panel is a room inside Dizko. It uses dizko.app's web theme as its token source (EventChat web/src/index.css and components/arc/dizko-theme.css): a near-black ground, off-white type in three steps, one hairline border colour and a single acid green. A DJ moving between dizko.app and the panel should not notice a seam. Restraint is the register: this is an Operate surface the DJ keeps open for 20 to 30 minutes while a mix is identified, so it stays quiet and lets the tracklist carry the page.

Density is high and flat. Everything sits on the one ground, divided by 1px hairlines in the border colour; there are no cards, no tinted panels and no shadows. Acid is reserved for meaning: the one filled action, ticked boxes, listening progress, and the marker swiped across a track that is in the cart. Dark is the default, as on dizko.app. A light system setting swaps to Dizko's light palette, and every acid fill keeps its near-black text in both themes.

The tracklist keeps the lineup billing from the previous world: tracks confirmed by more than one clip are set larger than single-clip IDs, which sit beneath a "Plus N unconfirmed" heading and start unticked.
keyCharacteristics: One self-hosted variable face, Instrument Sans, semibold with tight tracking for titles; upright only, sentence case only.
Acid means act or carted; it never decorates.
Hairline rules, not boxes. Flat, no elevation.
Pill buttons, softly rounded fields and menus (12px), small square checkboxes (4px).
Dark default, light variant from the system setting.

rules.name: The Acid Means Something Rule
rules.body: Acid appears only on the primary action, a ticked box, listening progress, the carted-track marker and the SoundCloud launcher. Text selection uses the hairline colour so acid is never ambient.

rules.name: The Ink On Acid Rule
rules.body: Anything filled with acid carries Acid Ink text, in dark and light alike.

rules.name: The Billing Rule
rules.body: Confirmed tracks are set at Headline; single-clip IDs drop to Track Small under the Title Small "Plus N unconfirmed" heading. Size carries confidence.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Dizko's uppercase buttons are not carried over. Every label, button, tab and heading is sentence case and upright.

rules.name: The Rules Not Boxes Rule
rules.body: Rows and sections are separated by a 1px hairline. Content is never grouped into cards, tiles or tinted panels.

rules.name: The One Plane Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, glow or blur on anything. A raised element is told apart by fill, not by depth.

dos: Do take colour values from Dizko's web theme; dark values match dizko.app's dark palette exactly.
Do keep exactly one acid-filled primary button per state.
Do separate rows and sections with a 1px hairline in the border colour.
Do set Acid Ink text on every acid fill, in both themes.
Do bill confirmed tracks at Headline and unconfirmed ones at Track Small under the "Plus N unconfirmed" heading.
Do keep disabled checkboxes at full colour while a cart run is going.
Do use the 2px focus outline with 2px offset: acid on dark, Text on light.
donts: Don't use acid outside the primary action, ticks, progress, the carted marker and the SoundCloud launcher; text selection stays neutral.
Don't carry over Dizko's uppercase button labels; everything is sentence case.
Don't add box-shadow, glow or blur, menus included.
Don't group tracks or settings into cards, tiles or tinted panels.
Don't colour a store's missing stock as an error; only failures use Miss.
Don't set italic or oblique type, or put a label above a heading.
